text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle suffered an injury,
so I hurried her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ouch...! Gh...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry for worrying you.
That was careless of me."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Still, it's like... I really don't want to just stop here..."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want to give in to an injury.
So, um... is it okay if I keep going?"
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard, will you?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Yeah, I guess so.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Man, this sucks... I finally made it to a stage where I could give it my all.
What am I even doing...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—I promise I'll recover from this injury in no time.
I don't have a second to waste standing still.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To recover from her injury,
K.S.Miracle took some time away to recuperate...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course!
I won't overdo it, but I'll do the best I can.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
One, two. One, two...
If I just take it slow like in rehab—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'm okay, totally fine.
Something like this won't bother me at all.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: That's why, just a little bit more—
choice_data_list: Let's heal up completely, and then we'll make up for lost time.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ......Yes. Understood.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer.
After you had such high hopes for me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Alongside the dejected KS Miracle,
I headed back to the infirmary once again...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, I'm fine! If it's just this much, I think I can keep going...!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Running might be out of the question, but at least we can prevent her from losing muscle.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... This is also thanks to you
believing in me, Trainer.
—Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after undergoing gradual training,
K.S. Miracle made a smooth and successful comeback.
